name: Research Plan
github_basis: GitHub Project with a single-select 'Research phase' field and an iteration field; roadmap view; one milestone per phase; a pinned roadmap issue
convention: Phased-plan convention: the 'Research phase' field uses the fixed lifecycle vocabulary; the roadmap issue is the human-readable plan-of-record and is edited as the plan changes
traceability_role: Anchors every work item to a phase and milestone

name: Activity Tracker
github_basis: Issues as tasks (issue forms, activity labels, sub-issues, assignees) surfaced on the Project board with Status/Priority and built-in workflows
convention: Every task issue carries an activity label and a phase; sub-issues decompose milestones
traceability_role: Task -> commit -> PR chain starts here

name: Question Register
github_basis: One dedicated issue per research question (title 'RQ-n: ...', 'research-question' label or org Issue Type), pinned index issue
convention: Question Register convention: methods/analysis issues and PRs reference their RQ issue; reformulations are timeline comments prefixed 'reformulated:'
traceability_role: Root node of the provenance chain

name: Discussion Space
github_basis: Discussions with categories (Q&A, Ideas, Poll) and mark-as-answer
convention: Methodological deliberation happens in Discussions; the accepted answer or poll result is referenced from the decision record

name: Documentation Set
github_basis: /docs Markdown (charter, protocol, methodology, roadmap) and a README per folder; optional GitHub Pages
convention: Documentation is written from project start, not at dissemination; each folder README is a data dictionary
traceability_role: Describes every artifact in place, with history

name: Decision Log
github_basis: A versioned DECISION_LOG.md plus a 'decision' issue per significant decision
convention: Decision-record convention: each decision gets a Dn entry (date, context, decision, rationale, alternatives, affects) and an issue that cross-references the affected artifacts; superseding decisions link back
traceability_role: Explains why the project is the way it is

name: Linkage Discipline
github_basis: Cross-references, closing keywords and the issue/PR timeline
convention: Linkage-discipline convention (mandatory): every commit names its issue; every PR uses 'Closes #'; every issue names its RQ and milestone; releases inherit the chain via autogenerated notes
traceability_role: The connective tissue that makes provenance reconstructable

name: Change History
github_basis: Git commit history (signed, co-authored) and tags for named states
convention: Conventional, scoped commit messages; annotated tags at phase boundaries
traceability_role: Line-level, attributable history of every artifact

name: Artifact Workspace
github_basis: Repository structure (literature/, data/, analysis/, framework/, manuscript/, ...); Git LFS for mid-size binaries; links out for large data
convention: Fixed top-level layout from the template; anything too large for the repo lives in an external store and is linked by reference
traceability_role: Single navigable index of in-scope artifacts

name: Review Workflow
github_basis: Feature branches, pull requests, formal reviews, CODEOWNERS, a PR template with a reproducibility checklist
convention: Substantive changes to analysis, methodology or manuscript go through a reviewed PR; the PR checklist gates 'results reproduced? data documented?'
traceability_role: Bundles rationale + diff + approval + linked issues

name: Automation Suite
github_basis: GitHub Actions: structure/link/Markdown validation, figure regeneration, matrix reproducibility run, release packaging; reusable workflows; Dependabot
convention: Checks run on every PR and on a schedule; job summaries and artifacts are retained; the analysis re-runs on a pinned environment

name: Release Process
github_basis: Tagged GitHub Releases per research version with autogenerated notes and attached assets; CITATION.cff kept current
convention: A release is cut at each roadmap point (v0.1 concept ... v1.0 paper); notes are the version-to-version changelog
traceability_role: Fixed, citable point linked to all work since the last release

name: Archival Bridge
github_basis: The GitHub-Zenodo release webhook; ORCID linkage
convention: Enabled once; every release is archived and assigned a DOI; the DOI is added to README and CITATION.cff
traceability_role: External persistent identifier and preservation for each output

name: Governance Setup
github_basis: Repository roles and teams, visibility policy, CONTRIBUTING and community-health files, organisation audit log
convention: Private during the work, public at publication is an explicit decision; roles: PI admin, collaborators write, reviewers triage; a documented archival-exit route
traceability_role: Records who may do what, and the exit plan

name: Transparency Surface
github_basis: Public (or shared) visibility, GitHub Pages summary, Insights/Pulse
convention: At publication the repository is made public with its full history; a Pages page summarises status and how to navigate it
traceability_role: Emergent from B1, B3, B4 and A1 once visible
